title: Business Spaces is a core menu item: a left rail shortcut, first in the Community menu, and a link in the public site header

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-16: "We need to add Business Spaces as a core menu item. That directory should be prominent in any navigation."

detail: The Business Spaces directory (/spaces/directory, public twin /discover/spaces) was only the fifth row of the Community mega menu, gated to members. It becomes a left rail shortcut for every viewer (Journal gives up its slot and stays in the You menu), leads the Community menu's People and places column with its own photo card, and is a plain link in the public Frequency site header, the phone sheet and the footer. A signed-out visitor who opens /spaces/directory is already sent to /discover/spaces by the (main) layout.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const n=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/members/shell/nav.ts','utf8');const s=fs.readFileSync('lib/frequency/site-nav.ts','utf8');const bad=[];const sc=n.slice(n.indexOf('export const FQ_SHORTCUTS'),n.indexOf('export const FQ_YOU_LINKS'));if(!/label: 'Business Spaces', sub: '', href: '\/spaces\/directory'/.test(sc))bad.push('not a left rail shortcut');if(/href: '\/spaces\/directory', icon: 'space', navKey/.test(n))bad.push('hidden from some viewers in the member menu');const d=s.slice(s.indexOf('export const DIRECT_LINKS'),s.indexOf('export const SIDE_CTA'));if(!d.includes(\"label: 'Business Spaces'\"))bad.push('not in the public site header');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-962: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
